beanie-coffee-van.alt: Tables, chairs and green umbrellas on the grass around the Beanie coffee van under a large gum tree, with people sitting in the sun.

beanie-coffee-van-2.alt: The serving hatch of the Beanie coffee van, a converted horse float, with cups stacked on the timber counter and chairs set out on the grass.

bribes-gift-shop-and-fresh-flowers.alt: The Sue's Bribes shopfront on the brick paving, its sign listing souvenirs, beach toys, clothes and jewellery, with Scallywags alongside.

bribes-gift-shop-and-fresh-flowers-2.alt: Racks of clothing under the awning at Sue's Bribes, with a feather flag on the paving and Scallywags' tables to the right.

cafe-54.alt: The Cafe 54 corner on Maurice Avenue, with street-side tables in its branded barriers and the pharmacy and Foodworks beyond.

cafe-54-2.alt: Cafe 54 from along the footpath, its timber gable sign above the open frontage and blackboard menus beside the door.

colin-dixon.alt: A coloured-pencil style portrait of Colin Dixon, smiling in a patterned shirt with sunglasses pushed up on his head, outside a brick house.

iga-local-grocer-mallacoota.alt: The IGA Local Grocer and Liquor shopfront under a clear sky, with newspaper stands beside the entrance.

iga-local-grocer-mallacoota-2.alt: The brick corner of the IGA Local Grocer building, with the Home Timber and Hardware mural along the side wall.

lees-pizza-take-away.alt: Lee's Pizza and Take Away under its curved verandah, with Chinese Take Away, burgers and fish and chips lettered on the windows.

lucys-chinese-restaurant.alt: Lucy's Chinese Restaurant behind its red and white striped awnings, with timber benches either side of the door.

mallacoota-arts-council.alt: The Croajingolong Centre for Communications and the Arts on Maurice Avenue, with a large woven circular sculpture on its timber wall.

mallacoota-arts-council-2.alt: The glazed entrance to the Croajingolong Centre under its angled timber canopy, the woven sculpture on the wall alongside.

mallacoota-bakery.alt: The Mallacoota Bakery shopfront with its hand-lettered sign, steps up to the open door and people at the tables behind the picket fence.

mallacoota-community-opportunity-shop.alt: The Mallacoota Community Opportunity Shop, its name lettered across the parapet above wide display windows.

mallacoota-community-opportunity-shop-2.alt: The Opportunity Shop frontage from the footpath, notices in the windows and Lee's takeaway sign beyond.

mallacoota-foodworks.alt: The Foodworks supermarket frontage on Maurice Avenue, with orange teardrop flags and benches along the footpath.

mallacoota-foodworks-2.alt: The Foodworks building from up the street, its curved awning running the length of the shops.

mallacoota-foodworks-3.alt: Foodworks with its open flag out, benches and a bin enclosure on the footpath and the pharmacy next door.

mallacoota-halls-and-recreation-communit.alt: The community hall at the precinct, a long stone and rendered building under a broad corrugated roof, seen across mown grass.
A newer grey building at the community precinct, with the inlet and far hills behind it.
The playground at the community precinct under its shade sails, with a slide, climbing frame and a picnic shelter alongside.
The skate park across the lawn, with riders on the bowl and a bench under the trees.
The skate park close up, its ramps and shade shelter beside picnic tables under a large gum.

mallacoota-hotel-motel-bistro.alt: The Mallacoota Hotel Motel sign listing pool, beer garden, family bistro and function room, above the Bottlemart drive-through.

mallacoota-hotel-motel-bistro-2.alt: The hotel's family bistro entrance on the corner, with TAB and Fox Sports signs along the frontage.

mallacoota-hotel-motel-bistro-beer-garde.alt: The Outside Bar in the hotel's beer garden, a timber and corrugated iron shelter beside the brick courtyard and palms.

mallacoota-hotel-motel-bistro-bottleshop.alt: The Bottlemart drive-through bottle shop at the hotel, with the motel reception beyond the entry.

mallacoota-meats.alt: The butcher's shopfront beneath its Try a Little Tenderness sign, with community notices in the window.

mallacoota-pony-club.alt: Riders and ponies on a sand track through regrowing bush at Mallacoota.

mallacoota-surf-shack.alt: The timber-clad Surf Shack building with its red sign over the entrance and a surf-brand mural along the side wall.

mallacoota-transfer-station.alt: The Victoria Container Deposit Scheme collection point, a blue shipping container with an access ramp, on gravel with the inlet behind.

mallacoota-visitor-information.alt: The visitor information centre, customer service centre and library, with its ramp and signs facing the street.

mallacoota-visitor-information-2.alt: The visitor centre across its lawn and hedge, signed for the foreshore holiday park, visitor information and the library.

mallacoota-visitor-information-3.alt: The Mallacoota Service Centre from the road, its teal panelling and ramp beside the visitor centre.

mallacoota-youth-and-sports-club.alt: The youth and sports club building at Lions Park, with bright green cladding and young plantings out the front.

mallacoota-youth-and-sports-club-3.alt: The club pavilion beside the oval, its verandah looking out over the grass to the light towers.

mallacoota-youth-and-sports-club-tennis.alt: The tennis courts behind their wire fence, with a Mallacoota Youth and Sports Club banner and a note advertising social tennis on Sundays.

scallywags-seafood-winebar.alt: The corner frontage of Scallywags, with its pirate emblem, wine barrels and outdoor tables on the brick paving.

scallywags-seafood-winebar-2.alt: Scallywags from the paved forecourt, umbrellas over its tables and the upstairs balcony above.

sundayss.alt: The Sundayss shopfront on the walkway, with a thatched awning and a surfboard sign above the door.

the-wilderness-collective.alt: The Wilderness Collective shopfront, its windows lettered Learn with us, Build with us, Work with us, with a table and chairs outside.
